Locked in solitary confinement, he said thank you.

Kevin Trudeau describes his nightly ritual in prison. He gave thanks for his mind, his health, the people who love him, the ability to love others freely, and blessings he did not even know about yet.

He ended each night with the words: I love my life. He says doing this helps you release and let go.

What could you be thankful for tonight, even on a hard day?
